zh.principle: **算法**：CMAC 分组密码 MAC（CMAC）。留存文本 §5.2 把结构关系写明：「The CMAC algorithm depends on the choice of an underlying symmetric key block cipher.The CMAC algorithm is thus a mode of operation (a mode, for short) of the block cipher.The CMAC key is the block cipher key (the key, for short).」即 CMAC 不自带分组密码，它选定一个分组密码并把该密码的密钥直接当作 MAC 密钥。§4.1 的 MAC 定义给出产出物的性质：「A bit string of fixed length, computed by a MAC generation algorithm, that is used to establish the authenticity and, hence, the integrity of a message.」
zh.why: 动机写在 §3 的第一句里，即被替代者的缺陷：「The basic Cipher Block Chaining MAC algorithm (CBC-MAC) has security deficiencies [9].」文本紧接着说明 CMAC 的核心是 Black 与 Rogaway 提出并分析过的 XCBC 变体。换言之，CMAC 的存在理由不是再加一种 MAC，而是在保留分组密码实现的前提下修补 CBC-MAC 的已知缺陷。
zh.used: 用法上的硬约束写在 §5.5：「The length of T, denoted Tlen, is a parameter that shall be fixed for all invocations of CMAC with the given key.」也即截断长度是同一密钥下的固定参数，不能逐条消息临时改变；§5.5 同时把取值要求交给附录规定。因此协议里以`同一密钥 + 固定截断长度`的方式部署 CMAC，而不是在同一密钥下混用多种标签长度。
zh.broken: 限度有三处可核。其一是被替代关系本身：§3 说 CBC-MAC「has security deficiencies [9]」，说明直接把链式加密的输出当 MAC 用是不安全的，CMAC 正是为此而生的修正。其二是依赖面：§5.2「The CMAC algorithm depends on the choice of an underlying symmetric key block cipher」，底层分组密码一旦被攻破，CMAC 的安全性随之失效。其三由 §5.5 的反面给出：Tlen 在同一密钥下必须固定，混用长度即偏离文本规定。
zh.history:
版本事实由文本自己给出：§1 写明「This publication is the second Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers.」题头行则是「Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CMAC Mode for Authentication」，即 SP 800-38B 是分组密码模式系列的第二份，专讲认证；本留存件的扉页日期为 2005 年 5 月。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: CMAC (CMAC 分组密码 MAC). Section 5.2 of the retained text states the structural relation: "The CMAC algorithm depends on the choice of an underlying symmetric key block cipher. The CMAC algorithm is thus a mode of operation (a mode, for short) of the block cipher. The CMAC key is the block cipher key (the key, for short)." So CMAC carries no cipher of its own: it selects a block cipher and reuses that cipher's key as the MAC key. The §4.1 definition of a MAC gives the property of the output: "A bit string of fixed length, computed by a MAC generation algorithm, that is used to establish the authenticity and, hence, the integrity of a message."
en.why: The motive sits in the first sentence of §3, naming the deficiency of what it replaces: "The basic Cipher Block Chaining MAC algorithm (CBC-MAC) has security deficiencies [9]." The text then identifies the core of CMAC as the XCBC variant proposed and analysed by Black and Rogaway. In other words, CMAC exists not to add another MAC but to patch a known weakness of CBC-MAC while still running on a block cipher.
en.used:
The operational constraint is printed in §5.5: "The length of T, denoted Tlen, is a parameter that shall be fixed for all invocations of CMAC with the given key." The truncation length is therefore fixed per key and cannot be chosen message by message, with §5.4 handing the selection requirements to an appendix. Deployments use one key with one fixed tag length rather than mixing tag lengths under the same key.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Three limits are checkable. First, the replacement relation itself: §3 says CBC-MAC "has security deficiencies [9]", so chaining encryptions and using the result as a MAC is unsafe, and CMAC is the correction. Second, the dependency printed in §5.2: "The CMAC algorithm depends on the choice of an underlying symmetric key block cipher" — a broken block cipher takes CMAC's security with it. Third, the converse of §5.4: Tlen must stay fixed for all invocations under a given key, so mixing tag lengths departs from the text.
en.history: The version facts come from the text itself. §1 states "This publication is the second Part in a series of Recommendations regarding modes of operation of symmetric key block ciphers." The cover line reads "Recommendation for Block Cipher Modes of Operation: The CMAC Mode for Authentication", so SP 800-38B is the second part of the block cipher modes series and is devoted to authentication; the retained copy is dated May 2005.

zh: CMAC：以分组密码为内核、由 CBC-MAC 修正而来的消息认证码模式。
Tlen：同一密钥下必须固定的标签长度参数。
subkey：由密钥 K 与常量 Rb 导出的 K1/K2，用于区分末块处理。
Rb：仅由分组位数决定的比特串常量，如 R128 与 R64。
CBC-MAC：把链式加密末块直接当 MAC 的原始构造，本建议指其有安全缺陷。
MAC：定长比特串，用来确立消息的真实性从而确立完整性。
en: CMAC: the block-cipher-based MAC mode derived as a correction of CBC-MAC.
Tlen: the tag length that must stay fixed for all invocations under one key.
Subkey: K1/K2 derived from the key K and the constant Rb to separate last-block handling.
Rb: a bit string determined solely by the block size, e.g. R128 and R64.
CBC-MAC: the original construction that uses the final chained block as a MAC, cited here as having security deficiencies.
MAC: a fixed-length bit string used to establish the authenticity, hence the integrity, of a message.
